sites.name: swept-position-add
sites.find:
swept_position =
                        Vector3(px, py, pz) + Vector3(sweep_x, sweep_y, sweep_z);

replacements.name: reverse-vectors
replacements.text:
swept_position =
                        Vector3(sweep_x, sweep_y, sweep_z) + Vector3(px, py, pz);

replacements.name: direct-position-first
replacements.text:
swept_position = Vector3(
                        px + sweep_x, py + sweep_y, pz + sweep_z);

replacements.name: direct-sweep-first
replacements.text:
swept_position = Vector3(
                        sweep_x + px, sweep_y + py, sweep_z + pz);

replacements.name: direct-native-x-order
replacements.text:
swept_position = Vector3(
                        sweep_x + px, py + sweep_y, pz + sweep_z);
